Expand the "export validation" for all ui components.

This otherwise causes issues with ComponentProps being undefined for users who don't have JSX instantiated. The tests already existed, but weren't running for the new files that are in folders.

Also add a new test for a different case where ComponentProps can be unknown and thus cause type errors.

**Result**

no destructures of "hidden" types in the type files of instantsearch-ui-components
